## What's new

- **Set your public address in Settings.** Administrators can now change the server's public address under Settings → Administration → Mobile & Pro, and the change takes effect without a restart. On Desktop, the local instance no longer locks this setting, so you can set an address instead of being told to edit `APP_URL`. The address you save is kept across quit and relaunch.
- **Add a passkey for another address.** If your server's address changes, add a passkey for the new address from Settings → Account → Passkeys. You confirm with an existing passkey and get a one-time link or code. Your other passkeys and sessions stay as they are, with no account recovery needed.
- **BigBrain on the Desktop local instance.** The local BigBrain vault connector can now be set up on the Ficus that Desktop runs on your Mac, following the local setup guide. End-to-end use with the BigBrain app on a packaged Mac install has not been verified yet. Instances that can't support it show why the connector is unavailable.
- **Shared BigBrain vaults on Ficus Cloud.** Ficus Cloud servers can host managed shared BigBrain vaults that people write to with the BigBrain app and agents read from, only for vaults you assign to a squad.
- **More reliable monitors.** Agents can choose whether a background monitor runs in their own box or the squad's, and a monitor that can't start now reports the real error instead of retrying as if the machine had restarted.
- **Smaller fixes.** Squad Home shows the manager above active work, the composer's context ring tracks a live turn, task updates in the Assistant are tidier, and GitHub edit attribution handles more title histories.
